caption: The drawing depicts a garment, specifically a jacket or coat, rendered in colored pencil. The jacket is primarily red with greenish-blue accents outlining its edges and smaller details. The garment features a jagged, starburst-shaped collar that extends outward in points, encircling a central circular neck opening. Similar jagged edges are present at the hem and the cuffs of the sleeves. There are round, button-like elements and additional greenish detailing on the front and sleeves. The background is a plain beige color, with the drawing centralized on a slightly textured, off-white paper that has a border, and there is a small area of discoloration at the upper right corner.
title: Jacket
